answer: A guarantor vouch bond makes sybils pay from a sponsor's pocket at the entry horizon. First, a newcomer trades only after an established agent locks 300 tokens as guarantor. Second, the guarantor earns 5 tokens a month while the newcomer behaves, capped at 60 yearly. Third, one upheld fraud verdict slashes the full 300-token bond and stamps the guarantor's record as a permanent relic. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 guarantors risking $30,000 and 12 months of history each; one honest agent costs a single $30 stake. Like a canyon crossing, only a bridge backed by someone across holds.
